title: Oceano_Eth
tagline: A blockchain-based AI model to preserve and protect the ocean and marine ecosystem
description: Oceano Eth is a comprehensive artificial intelligence and blockchain-based solution that generates a singular and optimised output for marine ecosystem conservation. DAPP, IoT, AI for creature detection, and AI for climatic analysis are the four components that make up the model. Data collected by IoT devices in the ocean is then recorded in a distributed ledger. The DAPP provides the incentive for fishermen, sailors, and coastal residents to carry the IOT tool kits. Funds and donations received for this cause will be returned in the form of NFT badges that can be used for ecosystem governance, and the AI will provide real-time updates on animal population density, ocean cleanliness percentage, and ecosystem-wide statistics to all stakeholders.
